description: Outcome of applying an ordered batch of Notion page/block operations through NotionOperationEngine. Applied tells the caller how many operations landed before a failure, so a partial batch can be reasoned about rather than silently discarded.

members.name: Errors
members.description: Human-readable errors; empty when Success is true.

members.name: Applied
members.description: Number of operations that were applied.

members.name: CreatedIds
members.description: Ids of the blocks or pages created by the batch.

members.name: ErrorCode
members.description: Machine-readable error code; defaults to McpToolResults.InvalidOperation.
